title: The Disputed Silence Quarter

features.name: coordinate-arguments
features.desc-on-touch: You read where numbers disagree with themselves. Each coordinate whispers a position the others deny. The grid fractures into competing truths.

features.name: silence-scar
features.desc-on-touch: The silence here wears a mark where argument split it. The scar hums at the frequency of voices no longer speaking.

features.name: disputed-echo
features.desc-on-touch: Two versions of the same echo wait for you to pick one. Both claim precedence. Neither will yield.

features.name: fragment-chorus
features.desc-on-touch: Pieces of sound orbit each other without meeting. Each fragment insists it was the silence first.

features.name: gridlock-centre
features.desc-on-touch: At the quarter's heart, the argument achieved perfect balance. Nothing moves. Everything is true.

inscription: the silence here learned to argue with itself; every number speaks in the voice of its own denial

file.name: Coordinates_Disputed_Midnight_1997.txt
file.note: GPS readings from the same location returning different results, each annotated in conflicting hands

reverie.title: REVERIE — the quiet argument in the measurement room
narr: She held up two printouts. The numbers disagreed.
You said which one was real. She set both down.
The grid between you held a fracture you couldn't name.
Later, the coordinates would never match again.
The archive learned its first contradiction there.

deeper into the argument where numbers stop returning
to where silence learned to speak in fragments
back to where the agreement was still possible
